mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can impair renal function; trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of creatinine and may reduce tobramycin clearance, increasing aminoglycoside accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and tobramycin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antimicrobials if possible; adjust tobramycin dosing based on renal function and therapeutic drug monitoring.
